title: Mainnet publish readiness: deterministic build version + service worker update verification

requirements.summary: Ensure the frontend publish process produces a new deterministic build/version identifier and that the PWA service worker update banner reliably appears after a mainnet publish, aligned with the DEPLOYMENT.md runbook.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend build/version identifier is deterministic on production builds via VITE_BUILD_VERSION and is visibly reflected in the UI build indicator.
Service worker is registered with a versioned URL tied to the build identifier, so a new publish triggers an update flow for existing users.
DEPLOYMENT.md provides clear, executable mainnet publish and post-deploy smoke test steps, including service worker update verification.

file_operations.description: Add a production-time safeguard that warns (console-only) when VITE_BUILD_VERSION is missing during a production build, while keeping existing version derivation behavior unchanged; this helps prevent accidental publishes without a new deterministic build/version identifier.

Tighten the mainnet publish runbook to explicitly require setting a new VITE_BUILD_VERSION for each production publish, and add/clarify verification steps for: (1) build indicator changed, (2) service worker registered successfully, and (3) users on the old version see the ServiceWorkerUpdateBanner and can apply the update to reload into the new version.
